title: Раздельные представления
verify: SELECT 'f' AS t, id, name, age, gender, address FROM v_persons_female UNION ALL SELECT 'm', id, name, age, gender, address FROM v_persons_male ORDER BY 1, 2

negative.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_persons_female AS SELECT * FROM person WHERE gender = 'male';
CREATE VIEW v_persons_male AS SELECT * FROM person WHERE gender = 'female';

negative.why: в представлениях не все атрибуты (нет адреса)
negative.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_persons_female AS SELECT id, name, age, gender FROM person WHERE gender = 'female';
CREATE VIEW v_persons_male AS SELECT id, name, age, gender FROM person WHERE gender = 'male';

negative.why: нет фильтра: представление женщин содержит всех
negative.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_persons_female AS SELECT * FROM person;
CREATE VIEW v_persons_male AS SELECT * FROM person WHERE gender = 'male';
CREATE VIEW v_persons_female AS SELECT * FROM person WHERE gender = 'female';
